definition.summary: Setting Ranger KMS context path to / (RANGER-4993)
Move GC/Zing flags into tez-site cluster-default cmd-opts and remove phantom tez.am.java.opts

set.value: -server -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -Dodp.version=${odp.version} -XX:+UseNUMA -XX:+ResizeTLAB{{heap_dump_opts}}{% if java_version|int == 8 %} -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+PrintGCDetails -verbose:gc -XX:+PrintGCTimeStamps{% elif jvm_tuning_profile == 'azul_prime' %} -Xlog:gc*:file=<LOG_DIR>/tez_am_gc.log:time,uptime,level,tags:filecount=10,filesize=10M -XX:+UseTransparentHugePages -XX:CIMaxCompilerThreads=8 -XX:+UseZingMXBeans{% else %} -Xlog:gc*:file=<LOG_DIR>/tez_am_gc.log:time,uptime,level,tags:filecount=10,filesize=10M -XX:+UseG1GC{% endif %}{% if java_version|int > 11 %} {{jvm_flags}}{% endif %}

-server -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -Dodp.version=${odp.version} -XX:+UseNUMA -XX:+ResizeTLAB{{heap_dump_opts}}{% if java_version|int == 8 %} -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+PrintGCDetails -verbose:gc -XX:+PrintGCTimeStamps{% elif jvm_tuning_profile == 'azul_prime' %} -Xlog:gc*:file=<LOG_DIR>/tez_task_gc.log:time,uptime,level,tags:filecount=10,filesize=10M -XX:+UseTransparentHugePages -XX:CIMaxCompilerThreads=8 -XX:+UseZingMXBeans{% else %} -Xlog:gc*:file=<LOG_DIR>/tez_task_gc.log:time,uptime,level,tags:filecount=10,filesize=10M -XX:+UseG1GC{% endif %}{% if java_version|int > 11 %} {{jvm_flags}}{% endif %}
